**Checklist**: `/testbed/specs/001-transactions/checklists/requirements.md` (all items passed)
**Feature JSON**: `/testbed/.specify/feature.json`

**Spec Highlights**:
- 4 user stories covering atomic batch operations (P1), table management (P2), nested mutable value rollback (P2), and persistence across close/reopen (P3)
- 9 functional requirements (FR-001 through FR-009) mapping directly to the 8 requirements (R01-R08) from the task, plus backward compatibility (FR-009)
- 5 measurable success criteria (SC-001 through SC-005) that are technology-agnostic
- 5 edge cases covering nested transactions, BaseException propagation, query cache invalidation, ID collisions, and multi-table mutations
- 8 assumptions documenting scope boundaries

**Quality Validation**: All 16 checklist items passed on first review. No NEEDS CLARIFICATION markers remain.

**Extension Hooks**: None registered (no `.specify/extensions.yml` file).
